_description: KPI dependency map for dc2_s — which downstream engines depend on each KPI/pillar. Used by configure_customer_kpis to warn when disabling load-bearing KPIs. One file per vertical (config/kpi_dependencies/<vertical>.json), matching the config/economics/<vertical>.json and config/investment/<vertical>.json convention — KPI codes are NOT globally consistent in meaning across verticals (P1-KPI1 here is 'Time-to-First-Workload'; the same code is 'Daily Active Users' on saas_premium), so this file must only ever be loaded for a dc2_s customer.
_generation_note: 2026-09-07: this file's dependencies/pillar_dependencies content is unchanged from the original flat config/kpi_dependencies.json — it was already vertical-correct for dc2_s (that was never the bug; the bug was every OTHER vertical silently reading this dc2_s-flavoured content too). Only relocated + given a self-declaring 'vertical' key so the loader can refuse a misfiled copy. Its 'metrics' values (TTFV/GRR/NRR/product_adoption/ticket_resolution_time/expansion_rate) are the old SaaS-parity business-outcome vocabulary from the retired repo's power_of_1_economics.json; kept as-is since they are inert documentation (only 'warning' is ever read by _check_kpi_dependencies in mcp_server/cs_pulse_onboarding.py — verified by grep, engines/metrics are never consumed by any code path) and changing them carries no behavioural effect. The 4 newly-generated verticals (datacenter_v1, saas_premium, healthcare_provider, manufacturing_iot) use the codebase's actual shared cross-vertical vocabulary instead (pillar_roles: adoption/engagement/reliability/capacity/revenue/expansion/partner/compliance, per utils/vertical_registry.py's role() and config/power_of_1.json's attribution.signal_role_to_pillar_role) rather than mechanically relabeling these six SaaS-specific names onto verticals that don't share dc2_s's SaaS-parity framing (dc2_s's own catalog carries saas_kpi_code/saas_category per KPI for exactly this comparison; the other 4 catalogs don't).
_source: config/dc2s_kpi_catalog.json (KPI names, weights, pillar_roles) + config/power_of_1.json (attribution.signal_role_to_pillar_role) + journeys/arc_classifier.py (rule roles) — NOT power_of_1_economics.json, which does not exist in this repo (that was a stale reference to the retired old repo; see memory backlog_power_of_1_linked_kpi_codes_dc2s_only.md, superseded).
